title: dish drying rack
text: dish drying rack. Have an extra deep stainless sink and nearly no counter space, so I chose to use this in one of my two stainless sinks.  Fits perfectly, works just as well.  The little feet have clear rubber/silicone like pieces over them so it helps to keep it in place and not scratch your surfaces. The edges are the black plastic which also helps to prevent scratches. The measurements given are spot on.  I really like it! I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

features: ATTRACTIVE LOW-PROFILE DESIGN: Unlike old-fashioned, bulky dish racks, which can be a true eyesore in your kitchen, Sinkin Dish Drying Rack has a clean, sleek design that you’ll barely notice; even when it’s full of dishes
REMOVABLE CUTLERY & UTENSIL HOLDER: Complete with drainage holes, Sinkin features a utensil and cutlery holder that can be removed or repositioned to suit your individual needs
MADE WITH DURABLE MATERIALS: Sinkin dish rack is made with durable polypropylene and coated wire. Rubber coated feet ensures it stays in place without scratching your countertop

WORKS WITH ALL SINK STYLES: Sinkin dish drainer works with all styles of sink, including standard drop-in sink, undermount sink, apron sink, corner sink or even a bar sink (just be sure to measure the base of your sink before ordering to ensure a proper fit)

SIMPLE, STURDY & STYLISH: Designed by Helen T. Miller for Umbra, Sinkin Dish Drying Rack measures 14 x 11 x 5.25 inches and is a simple, stylish way to air-dry dishes right in your sink, or on your countertop, while you get on with your day
description: Sometimes kitchens have limited storage or minimal storage for drying dishes. Alleviate this common kitchen issue with this thoughtfully designed drying rack from Umbra.
Sinkin is an in-sink dish drying rack that rests in the bottom of your kitchen sink (or on your countertop) and is a tidy and convenient way to air-dry dishes, glasses, and cutlery.
Constructed of coated metal wire and durable polypropylene, Sinkin features non-slip rubber feet that won't scratch your sink or countertop.
Sinkin Measures 14 x 11 x 5.25 inches and fits most standard kitchen sinks.
For a sleek and efficient take on the traditional kitchen sink caddy, order the Sinkin dish drying rack today.
